name: FaySummer Classic Day Camp
description_short: A general day camp at Fay School in Southborough for children age 3 through entering grade 6, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, in a launch week and four two-week sessions. Campers are grouped by grade and do sports, arts and crafts, a ropes/challenge course, and pool time, with younger groups on a more structured schedule. Discoverers (preschool to kindergarten) can attend half days.
refund_policy_summary: A non-refundable deposit is due at registration and is deducted from session fees. Cancelling before the payment due date gives a full refund minus the deposit; no refunds after the payment due date. Full refund if FaySummer cancels a program.
swim_waterfront_notes: All campers get time in the camp's pools. Discoverers (preschool to kindergarten) have swim lessons as part of their daily activities.

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown and it is already over (today is 2026-10-13). The page says 'Thank you for a great summer!' Dates and prices for 2027 have not been posted and may be different.
Prices listed are for full-day. Half-day is only for Discoverers (preschool to kindergarten): $395 for Launch Week, $790 for a two-week session. Extended care costs extra.
Activities are 'a sampling' from previous years. Not every activity is offered every week to every age group.
